execution_authority: User explicitly requested detailed reading and execution of the V0219 Goal; document-only initial status is historical.
rank_encoding: SHA256 of canonical JSON [goal_id, pool_version, revision, group_or_root_id, salt, seed]
A_grouping: Entire coarse occupational family is one conservative reserve-assignment group; original task roots remain separate descriptive units, semantic independence not presumed.
A_split: Families containing known old D remain development-only in their entirety. All remaining families are reserved without opening task semantics. This exposure-driven 9/13 vs 4/13 family allocation replaces within-family random splits to prevent uncertain semantic-template leakage.
A_D_order: Hash-order families and hash-order eligible candidate roots inside each family, then round-robin by family. Remove known old D and any additional historical-reference root conservatively; do not select by task outcome or expected failure.
C_admission: UNKNOWN_EXPOSURE and unvalidated automatic adapters remain ineligible. Reserve-assigned candidates are protected, not certified static accepted C; no semantic reads before F6 authority.
A_static_eligibility: pinned source/license and all assets verified
new non-old root in frozen development order
text-supported adapted action world with explicit source-grounded variation
all required source/record fields observable through normal tools
frozen full input plus output fits actual provider
no unsupported necessary modality or production service
candidate_processing: Sequential ACCEPT_STATIC / REJECT(reason) / HOLD, stop on accepted prefix or pool exhaustion; never replace NO_WRITE or model failures.
L_status: All non-index JSON candidate files inventoried; history grouping/modalities/context require separate admission. No L model allocation until a lane-specific diagnostic is registered.
S_status: Pinned code includes generators, not pre-generated timeline roots. New timeline/template contract required, no model allocation.
pool_exhaustion: Report actual accepted/root/family/group counts and shortfall; never silently extend revisions or treat repeats as new lineages.
C_semantic_catalog: Not created: no candidate C task body/gold extraction authorized at Seal A. Source map is private; only opaque IDs and neutral metadata exposed.
constructors_reviewers: Same developer; separate process or private directory is not independent human review.
